page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m2.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC processors running at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz. This virtual machine is provisioned via the KVM hypervisor and features 16 dedicated vCPUs alongside 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It lacks hardware-accelerated graphics processing units. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The hardware configuration represents a compute-focused profile where memory allocation is streamlined relative to the processing core count.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio make this instance suitable for compute-heavy workloads that do not demand massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, web serving, distributed analytics nodes, and application servers where CPU execution speed is prioritized over large in-memory databases.
